name: Accretion disk
description:
A Black hole is composed from different part. The Accretion disk slowly and with a huge force spirals matter towards the black hole. It is thin, hot and reminds one of molten glass. 

The piece is my visual representation of what it might look and feel like if you could survive the immense gravitational forces that rip apart your body cell by cell while getting sucked into one.

name: Sinet Motion C
description:
This generative art work is heavily influenced by Karl Sims' "Genetic Images" (1993).

A composite mathematical function made from sines, multiplications, and additions translates the three dimensional information of position and time at each pixel to a point in the three dimensional red-green-blue color-space.

The function is found through a process of artificial evolution where the value of another function of the resulting image is maximized.

This video file is 2 minutes long at 1080 by 1080 pixels and 30 frames per second.
